item.title: REF 0.11.0
item.description:
• Waveforms now come in RGB, the way rekordbox and Traktor colour theirs: lows red, mids green, highs blue, mixed into a colour for every moment. Kicks read red, kick and hats pink, hats blue, mids green. The colours were matched against rekordbox's own analysis of the same songs.
  • Sharper waveforms: one column per screen pixel, so a Retina screen shows twice the detail. Once a song is measured, the overview is drawn from its 3 ms detail, so each kick gets its own lines.
  • The old looks (Layers, Spectrum, Three bands, One colour) are still in Settings › Look › Waveform colours.
